dataset_origin.description: Original synthetic 6-unit inspections register and 5 defect records, frozen before manual gold and independent oracle under approved P12 fixture plan; no precomputed answer columns.
dataset_origin.limitations: Not UCI, real production data or a derived real-data snapshot. Case-sensitive ASCII string keys; unique unit_id in inspections and defect_id in defects; every defects.unit_id exists in inspections. Nonempty cells/no NULL; severity integer 1/2/3. Multiple records, including repeated defect_code and severity for one unit, are intentional. No time window or date transformation.

oracle_runtime.algorithm: Independent raw-CSV max severity per unit_id, then full inspections traversal with per supplier/line counts and max>0/max=3 flags; missing severity=0, shares over all inspected units, ASCII sorting, no intermediate rounding. Full manual 3×7 independently checked before native; no Loginom outputs used.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
